subject: Private Offer onboarding: billing routing, SSO proof, and acceptance gates
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer onboarding: first pass questions

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for walking us through the private offer this morning. A few items procurement/legal asked us to confirm so we can route the PO and start the acceptance window: 

1) Invoicing path: we need invoices to go to procurement@horizonhealth.com and a secondary copy to finance@horizonhealth.com. Does Redwood provide a consolidated monthly invoice per marketplace (AWS/GCP) or per PO?

2) SSO / proof of environment: legal asked for a short verification that the private offer will be provisioned under our AWS account (Private Offer) and that we can restrict data flow to our VPC. Can you point us to a customer-facing doc or provide a compliance statement we can attach to the PO?

3) Acceptance gates: procurement wants the acceptance checklist so they can sign off on timing (we may want to stagger acceptance across 2 regions). Any constraints on staged acceptance and billing cutover?

4) Term and uplift: leadership is considering moving from 12 to 24 months with a 30% capacity uplift (start month 1). Is that doable in the private offer amendment?

We'd like to turn around a draft PO by Friday if possible. I've attached the internal purchasing template (not the final PO).

Thanks —
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Sr. Sourcing Manager | Horizon Health
[attachment: horizon_onboarding_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer onboarding: first pass questions

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — this is great detail. Short answers up front, and then a proposed next step below: 

1) Invoicing: We can send a consolidated monthly invoice per private offer per marketplace (so separate invoice for AWS vs GCP if you accept both). We can cc an additional email (finance@horizonhealth.com) on the distribution. If you need a single combined invoice across marketplaces we can support that but it will be on a staggered cadence (we work with our billing ops team to reconcile).

2) SSO/proof: We have a standard attestation letter for private deploys that confirms provisioning to a customer-owned account (AWS Private Offer) and VPC isolation controls. I will attach the attestation and a short network diagram. For GCP Marketplace we have an equivalent deployment statement.

3) Acceptance gates: Staged/regional acceptance is supported. Practical notes: (a) billing begins when the acceptance flag is triggered for each region, (b) we recommend a 7-day canary window for the first region, and (c) we can add an interim capacity buffer to avoid throttling during the handoff.

4) Term/uplift: Yes — we can amend the private offer to 24 months and reflect the 30% uplift. We'll need a revised commitment schedule to generate a new private offer SKU and adjust pricing.

Proposed next step: I’ll draft an acceptance checklist and the attestation this afternoon and share a short PO routing sheet for your procurement team to complete. Marissa — can you pull the attestation and network diagram from LegalOps and drop the files here? Priyom — please prepare the routing-sheet template with invoice distribution fields.

If Friday looks tight for you, let us know and we can aim early next week.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[signature block]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>, Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer onboarding: first pass questions

On Thu, Jul 12, 2028 at 11:03 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kimberly asked me to drop the attestation and diagram.

Attaching the attestation letter and a simplified network diagram for the AWS private offer (PDF). Also adding a draft routing-sheet (XLSX) with the invoice distribution fields filled in per Sarah's request. Note the routing-sheet includes: invoice delivery emails, PO number field, billing contact, invoice remit address, and marketplace identifier (AWS/GCP).

Quick clarifications: 
- For combined invoicing across marketplaces, billing ops requires a signed PO that includes all marketplace SKUs and the preferred remit email. That is when we can issue a single consolidated invoice.
- Staggered acceptance: we record region-level acceptance timestamps; each region's billing starts on its acceptance timestamp.

Attachements: Horizon_PO_210728.pdf (attestation), routing-sheet.xlsx (billing routing), redlines_Horizon_legal.docx (initial legal redlines placeholder)

Marissa Cole
Director, Field Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal@horizonhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer onboarding: first pass questions

Thanks Kim/Marissa — the attestation and routing-sheet are exactly what procurement asked for. A couple of follow-ups from legal: 

- Legal asked whether Redwood can include a one-paragraph attestation in the PO that references the attestation PDF (so they have it inline in their procurement system).
- For the 24-month term + 30% uplift: procurement wants to see the revised SKU and a draft invoice schedule (monthly amounts) so they can estimate cashflow. Can Redwood provide a draft commitment schedule and the pricing delta?

We're aiming to circulate a draft PO + legal redlines to our internal approvers by EOD Monday. If Redwood can provide the draft SKU and a short invoice projection today, it will help speed approvals.

Sarah

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer onboarding: first pass questions

Hi Sarah —

Attached are two artifacts you can drop into the PO packet: (1) routing-sheet.xlsx prefilled (we exported as PDF for your procurement system) and (2) Horizon_PO_210728.pdf (attestation). I've also included a short commitment schedule and SKU mapping in the Drive link (private) and pasted a one-paragraph attestation below that you can copy into the PO body: 

"Redwood Inference attests that the services covered by this private offer will be provisioned into the Horizon Health customer-owned cloud accounts (as specified in the accompanying attestation PDF) and that VPC isolation controls will be applied as documented. Billing and acceptance will follow the acceptance checklist (attached)."

Draft commitment notes (high level): 
- Term: 24 months (start date: upon first regional acceptance)
- Commit uplift: +30% baseline capacity across committed SKUs
- Pricing: SKU-level delta and monthly invoice projection (drive link) — see: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Horizon-Onboard

Next steps: If you confirm the PO fields are filled, we can generate the private offer amendment and the DocuSign envelope. Legal redlines file received (redlines_Horizon_legal.docx) — Kim/Marissa, can LegalOps respond to the marked items (esp. IP/data clauses) so we can move to signature?

Thanks —
Priyom
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
